Definition: to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint a king
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pour out, pour, offer, cast; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to pour out; 1a2) to cast metal images; 1a3) to anoint (a king); 1b) (Niphal) to be anointed; 1c) (Piel) to pour out (as a libation); 1d) (Hiphil) to pour out libations; 1e) (Hophal) to be poured out; 2) to set, install; 2a) (Qal) to install; 2b) (Niphal) to be installed
